## 1. Indicators

108 artifact(s) under `datasets/indicators/in/`. The Temporal Richness meter projects each indicator's `coverage.temporal` span onto 7 cells of 3 fiscal years (buckets: FY06–FY08, FY09–FY11, FY12–FY14, FY15–FY17, FY18–FY20, FY21–FY23, FY24–FY26). Snapshots fill exactly one cell and carry a `(snapshot)` tag.

**Frontend wiring**: 100 of 108 indicator artifacts are referenced by [`topic-catalogue.json`](../../datasets/taxonomy/topics.json) and therefore reachable from the IA today; **the remaining 8 are on disk but unreachable from any topic / state hub** (see §1Z below). The catalogue is hand-maintained — every new ingest must add (or consciously skip) a catalogue entry, or the data quietly drifts out of the citizen view.
